selected_outcomes: Global matching rule for coefficients with a two-row index. Testing membership can require constructing large lists.
Positive rules for restricted output permutations or separated input supports. The two agents treated different families.
Unsigned matching count for all shapes and direct rules for hooks and two-row shapes. The all-shape construction uses an algebraic argument and has no established efficient membership test.
Coefficient formulas for restricted interval families, including Boolean-middle intervals with specified endpoints. Classical formulas cover some of the cases.
Both agents gave formulas for matrices of lower bandwidth at most one. Positivity on this family also follows from prior work.
